learning_outcomes.text: Students have basic knowledge and skills in a selected sub-area of computer science.
Students know practical concepts and applications in the selected sub-area of computer science.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods to solve problems independently and to communicate the solution.
Students have acquired competencies preferably from the area of Theoretical Computer Science.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solution for at least two exercise assignments
Written exam or oral examination (individual examination)

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution for at least two of these assignments. The examination consists of a written exam or an individual oral examination. Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
